name: minitok-extension
description: Verified coding workflows for the terminal
author: Flotic

untrustedWorkspaces.description: minitok runs repository-changing commands and requires a trusted workspace.

minitok.cliPath.description: Optional path to the Node.js minitok CLI (…/node_modules/@flotic/minitok/bin/minitok.js). Leave empty to auto-detect the npm package entry point, then minitok.cmd/minitok. Python minitok executables are not supported.

minitok.mcpCommand.description: Command used to connect the minitok MCP runtime. Use an argument array or quote paths containing spaces.

minitok.mcpScopes.description: MCP permissions for Extension-launched servers: read, write, auto_accept, verify_exec. Keep read-only unless broader access is explicitly required.

minitok.showCost.description: Show token and estimated cost summaries in the sidebar

minitok.evidencePath.description: Workspace-relative evidence file opened by the sidebar

minitok.autoApprove.description: Automatically approve minitok changes. Disabled by default for safety.

minitok.storeTaskText.description: Store full task text in local history and checkpoints. Disabled by default; previews and hashes are stored instead.

minitok.approvalTimeoutMs.description: How long a run waits for an approve/reject decision before the change is rejected (milliseconds, default 30 minutes).

minitok.runTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout after which the sidebar stops a run (milliseconds). 0 keeps a run alive for its approval timeout plus a 5-minute margin, so a late decision is never lost to the kill timer.

scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node --test test/process-contract.test.js test/mcp-config.test.js test/version.test.js test/spawn.test.js test/auth-ui.test.js
scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test test/process-contract.test.js test/mcp-config.test.js test/version.test.js test/spawn.test.js test/auth-ui.test.js && node dist/test/run-host.js
